# Library folder fixtures (feature 022)

Owner: qa (022 T023). Consumers: the E2E specs `e2e/tests/library-*.spec.ts` and
`e2e/a11y/library.a11y.spec.ts` (through `e2e/support/library-seed.ts`), the backend seeder
(022 T044) for the database fixtures, and the backend normalisation tests where they want the
same groups.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `scenarios.json` | normalisation groups (FR-004/FR-005, SC-002 E2E subset), tagged-upload filing songs (US1, mode `not-found`), the browse set (US2: an artist with three album covers, one with one cover, one without a picture), the search cases per instrument family and detail stem group (US3-3, SC-006), and the plan of the 5,000-item database fixtures (SC-003, SC-004) |
| `db/` (not committed) | `library-5000-pre022.db` and `library-5000.db`, written by the backend seeder |

## How the specs seed

- **Audio**: unique copies of `tests/fixtures/audio/click_120bpm_4-4_12s.wav` (generated by
  `generate_fixtures.py`) with a RIFF `LIST/INFO` chunk (`INAM` title, `IART` artist, `IPRD`
  album). The 005 upload details read these with tinytag as the import names (`lookup_title`,
  `lookup_artist`, `album`). The copy gets a new content hash per run (no worker cache hit).
- **Names**: every artist, album and song name gets the run salt (` qa<salt>`), so reruns on one
  data volume never share folders. Folder ids are taken from `Asset.placement`, never computed.
- **Mode**: tag-based filing expectations need `STEMSTUDIO_FAKE_ONLINE=not-found` (otherwise the
  fake match "The Fixture Band" > "Synthetic Sessions" wins, FR-003); those cases skip in other
  modes with the reason. Browse and search seeds set the track library info (source `track`), so
  they run in every mode.
- **Items**: through the public API only (`/api/assets/audio-exports`, `/stem-packs`, the 008
  score route, `/api/tracks/{id}/library-info`, `/api/assets/{id}/library-info`).

## 5,000-item database fixtures

Produced by the backend seeder (T044) into a folder qa names:

```bash
STEMSTUDIO_LIBRARY_SEED_OUT="$PWD/tests/fixtures/library/db" \
  dotnet test tests/StemStudio.Api.Tests --filter Category=Seed -v q
```

(The variable name is qa's request to backend-022; see `docs/handoffs/qa-022-wave1.md`.) The
specs tagged `@library-db` copy a file into the api container with `docker compose cp` (api
stopped, `-wal`/`-shm` removed), start the api and restore the original database afterwards
(`e2e/support/library-db.ts`); they need `E2E_COMPOSE=1` and run outside `npm test`.

## Provenance and licences

All names except the few public band, album and song names quoted in the spec (Metallica, Master
of Puppets, Battery, Motörhead, Ace of Spades, The Beatles, Guns N' Roses) are fictional and
self-written (CC0). No audio, picture or lyric is copied from anywhere.
